status_sections.Summary: Unagi 21.0.4 is Red, and the single biggest risk is the open blocker SPEC-5757 on that release. Over the last 30 days, open issues increased by 20, with 35 new and 15 resolved; hygiene remains weak with 183 issues missing a fix version, 120 missing a component, 59 missing an assignee, and 157 stale issues.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- SPEC-5757 is the only open blocker on Unagi 21.0.4; the release has 1 open issue and 66.7% done.
- Vimba 22.0.0 is Green, but it still has 2 open issues: SPEC-5672 and SPEC-5673.
- master is Green, but it still has 5 open issues: SPEC-5585, SPEC-5586, SPEC-5672, SPEC-5673, and SPEC-5688.
- There are 28 open blockers and criticals overall.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, and SPEC-5561 are long-lived blockers.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, SPEC-5747, SPEC-5758, SPEC-5764, and SPEC-5774 are open blockers with no assignee.
- SPEC-5375 and SPEC-5753 are open criticals.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Confirm priority for SPEC-5757 so the Unagi 21.0.4 release can move forward.
- Assign owners for the open blocker issues with no assignee: SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5734, SPEC-5740, SPEC-5741, SPEC-5747, SPEC-5758, SPEC-5764, and SPEC-5774.
- Decide whether SPEC-5672 and SPEC-5673 should block Vimba 22.0.0 and master.
- Confirm whether SPEC-5375 and SPEC-5753 need escalation handling beyond the current critical status.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Work SPEC-5757 to closure for Unagi 21.0.4.
- Triage the 28 open blockers and criticals, starting with the oldest items.
- Assign owners to the unassigned blocker issues.
- Clean up hygiene gaps: fix version, component, assignee, and stale issue coverage.
- Recheck release readiness for Unagi 21.0.4, Vimba 22.0.0, and master after blocker updates.
